findings.message:
Note that the current chown permission checks are all racy: no lock is held between the permission check and the update of the owner/mode, which leads to a TOCTOU problem. See https://github.com/asterinas/asterinas/pull/3864#discussion_r4236161483 for details.

However, this is very hard to fix under the current architecture, so we can tolerate the race for now. Please follow #3864 and just leave a FIXME.
findings.tp_fp_justification: do_chown runs all permission and set-ID-stripping checks on a Copy Metadata snapshot from path.metadata() (L113), which releases the inode lock before returning; the actual updates via path.set_owner/set_group/set_mode (L160-168) take fresh locks. A concurrent chown/chmod between check and update breaks Linux's serializable chown/chgrp semantics (same TOCTOU as #3864). tatetian acknowledges it is hard to fix under the current architecture and asks to leave a FIXME; author accepts. Defect window L113-168.
